intended_object: A helper inside the CKN (Caffarelli–Kohn–Nirenberg) weak-continuity-in-L³ proof. It takes a smooth spatial test field φ, whose values lie in the library's L2Vec3 type, turns each value into a Vec3 through the linear map weakContL3OfLp, and multiplies pointwise by a fixed scalar cutoff χ. Inferred from the docstring and from how the file uses it.
explanation: The definition only builds a specific test function, x ↦ χ(x)·φ(x), for one proof. The lemmas that follow it in the same file prove that this function is smooth, has compact support, and has support inside the spatial ball. It is then fed into the weak formulation of the equations. It depends on structures private to this file (weakContL3SmoothTest and weakContL3OfLp). It has no standalone counterpart in the mathematical literature. It is a technical device used in a proof, not a mathematical object.
